title: fix(rest): openapi.json documents a valid declared endpoint the served read decorated (#23083)
body:
Fixes #23083
Clause-②: no

## What was wrong

`GET /api/v1/openapi.json` folds the declared `api` items into the document through `selectDocumentableEndpoints` (`packages/rest/src/openapi-endpoints.ts`). Where no endpoint matcher is reachable, the handler passes it the items `protocol.getMetaItems({ type: 'api' })` serves. That read exits through `decorateMetadataItems`, which stamps `_diagnostics` on every `api` item. `ApiEndpointSchema` is closed, so the reader refused the platform's own badge by name (`unrecognized_keys: ["_diagnostics"]`): every valid declaration was left out of the document and logged at `error` as a declaration to fix.

## The change

- `selectDocumentableEndpoints` runs `stripReadDecorations` (`@objectstack/spec/kernel`) before `ApiEndpointSchema.safeParse`. It removes exactly `METADATA_READ_DECORATIONS` (`_diagnostics`, `_draft`), the same strip the seed door applies. There is no local key list and no blanket underscore strip, and the schema is unchanged.
- The ADR-0010 envelope keys (`_packageId`, `_provenance`, and the rest) are allowlisted by the schema and parse exactly as before. Any other unknown key is still refused.
- A truly invalid item is still omitted and logged at `error`. The log line's second sentence ("The endpoint matcher excludes it too, so the route it declares answers 404") is gone, because it was measured false (below). The line now reads: `[REST] stored api item 'NAME' does not satisfy ApiEndpointSchema — it is OMITTED from the OpenAPI document; fix the declaration rather than the document.`
- Changeset: `@objectstack/rest` patch, carrying `Clause-②: no`.

## Reach, measured on this tree (base `62ce45d140`)

The caller is the `GET {basePath}/openapi.json` handler, step 4 (`rest-server.ts`). Its read is `protocol.getMetaItems({ type: 'api' })`, served audience. The stamping site is `decorateMetadataItems` (`packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.ts`, the `audience === 'served'` exit). The raw items reach the reader only when `resolveEndpointMatchAuthority` finds no `metadata` service with `matchEndpoint`. With a matcher, the reader gets the matcher's own parsed endpoints, which carry no decoration, and the strip is a no-op that returns the same reference.

| composition | metadata slot has `matchEndpoint` | declared paths in `openapi.json` | omission lines at `error` |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| `@objectstack/verify` `bootStack(showcase)`, before | no (kernel in-memory fallback) | 0 of 2 | 2 |
| same, after | no | 2 of 2 | 0 |
| `os serve objectstack.config.ts` (showcase), after (CONTROL) | yes (`MetadataPlugin` since #23078) | 2 of 2 | 0 |

- On `bootStack`, `GET /api/v1/meta/api` answers both items with keys `_packageId`, `_packageVersion`, `_provenance` and `_diagnostics: {"valid":true}`.
- On both runs `bootStack` still logs the once-per-server notice "no endpoint matcher is reachable … which may advertise routes that answer 404". That is a different line, owned by `rest-server.ts`.
- On `bootStack` the declared route itself answers `GET /api/v1/apps/showcase/tasks` with `404 ENDPOINT_NOT_FOUND`, because nothing serves declared endpoints without a matcher. The document now lists both routes there, which is the stored-items fallback that notice describes. On `os serve` the same route answers `200`.
- `_draft` does not reach this reader today: the handler passes no preview mode to `getMetaItems`. The `_draft` pin covers robustness only.

Before, `bootStack`, one of the two lines:

```text
[REST] stored api item 'showcase_task_feed' does not satisfy ApiEndpointSchema — it is OMITTED from the OpenAPI document. The endpoint matcher excludes it too, so the route it declares answers 404; fix the declaration rather than the document. {"issues":[{"code":"unrecognized_keys","keys":["_diagnostics"],"path":[], …}]}
```

After, `bootStack`: no line names either endpoint.

## The matcher sentence, measured

The real `MetadataManager` holds the STORED item, and `matchEndpoint` is asked. The reader gets what the openapi.json caller hands it. Both measurements were taken on this tree before the change:

| case | matcher serves | reader documents (before) | reader's refusal |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| A: valid item through `decorateMetadataItems` | yes | no | `unrecognized_keys: _diagnostics` |
| B: valid item with `_draft: true` | yes | no | `unrecognized_keys: _draft` |
| C: truly invalid (`type: 'nope'`) | no | no | `invalid_value: type` |
| D: valid body in a flat stored envelope (`packageId`, `state`) | yes | no | `unrecognized_keys: packageId,state` |
| E: ADR-0010 `_packageId` | yes | yes | none |

The sentence held only in case C. The matcher peels the storage envelope before it parses, and on the composition where this reader sees raw items there is no matcher at all. After the change, A and B are documented, and C and D are still refused.

## Tests, at `76f507c0ee`

- New file `packages/rest/src/openapi-endpoints-read-decorations.test.ts`, 7 cases. Its fixtures are the real producer's output (`decorateMetadataItems` from `@objectstack/metadata-protocol`).
  - Pins: two valid items decorated by the served read are documented and nothing is logged; an item carrying `_draft` is documented; both decorated items become path entries; and `GET /openapi.json` with no matcher wired lists both endpoints, with no `console.error` line naming either.
  - CONTROLS: a decorated, truly invalid item is still omitted and logged, and its issues name `type` with no `unrecognized_keys`; `_packageId` and `_provenance` parse to exactly `ApiEndpointSchema.parse(item)`, decorated or not; `_unexpected` is still refused as `unrecognized_keys`.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/rest test`: `Test Files  275 passed (275)`, `Tests  5758 passed | 326 skipped (6084)`, lock `VERDICT command-exit 0`.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/rest typecheck`: exit 0. `check:test-typecheck: OK — @objectstack/rest's test layer compiles under packages/rest/tsconfig.test.json; 0 file(s) / 0 error(s)`. `tsc -p tsconfig.test.json --listFiles` includes the new file, 0 errors.
- Ablation, committed first. `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` replaced `ApiEndpointSchema.safeParse(stripReadDecorations(item))` with `ApiEndpointSchema.safeParse(item)`: anchor 1 to 0, blob `45e2bea3bfc8` to `258febe723a5`. It ran inside the verify lock under an EXIT/INT/TERM restore trap. No build was needed, because the tests import the subject from `src` by relative path. The direction was predicted before the run: 6 red, the `_unexpected` control green, the existing file green. Observed: `Tests  6 failed | 27 passed (33)`, exactly those 6. Restore: blob `45e2bea3bfc8` equals HEAD and `git diff HEAD` is empty.
- Gates: `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` derived 62 commands, identical with and without explicit paths. All 62 exit 0. `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` first exited 3 (`PREREQUISITE NOT MET`, 14 packages had no `dist/`) and exited 0 after the cli closure was built. `--ran`: `62 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 62 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED`.
- Lint, by proven narrowing (CI runs `pnpm lint`):
  - eslint `--no-inline-config --format json` over the 2 touched `.ts` files: 2 files, 0 errors, 0 warnings.
  - `--print-config` gives both files a config (6 and 5 rules). The changeset `.md` is outside eslint's population (`undefined`).
  - `eslint.config.mjs` enables no type-aware linting (no `parserOptions.project`, no `projectService`), and this diff touches none of its inputs. So no untouched file's verdict can move.

## Acceptance notes

- Not filed, carrier none: case D above. A valid body in a flat stored envelope (`packageId` / `state`) is refused by this reader while the matcher serves it, and the log still says to fix the declaration. No producer that hands this reader such rows was found, so its reach is unmeasured.
- Not filed, carrier: the next PR to touch this file. The module docblock "What it is HANDED" says the production caller passes the matcher-confirmed set. That holds only when a matcher is reachable. Without one, it passes the served items, which is the path this change repairs.
- This branch is one commit behind `origin/main` (`0aef788816`, `plugin-hono-server` only, disjoint from this diff). It is not merged.
- Not run locally: `pnpm --filter @objectstack/rest test:repo`. It is declared to CI.
